title: MRT MALDI Spot Analysis for Zooarchaeology by Mass Spectrometry of Collagenous Material
author: Frankie Tait

steps.title: Spot Peptide Samples
steps.instruction: Spot peptide samples 1:1 with α-Cyano-4-hydroxycinnamic acid (CHCA) (VWR Catalog #SIALC2020-10G).

substeps.instruction: Spot peptides first.
Mix with CHCA by pipetting 1 µL of each in a circular motion on the plate.
Ensure the final volume in each target well is 2 µL to cover the full surface area.

steps.title: Spot ADH Digestion Standard
steps.instruction: Spot 1 pMol/µL aliquots of Waters™ MassPREP ADH Digestion Standard (Waters Catalog #186002328) 1:1 with CHCA.

substeps.instruction: Spot 8 replicates using the same manner as the peptide extracts.
Ensure each spot has a final concentration of 500 fMol/µL.

steps.title: Dry the Plate
steps.instruction: Allow the plate to dry on a heater block at 35-50 °C to encourage crystallisation; remove as soon as the last spot has dried.

steps.title: Prepare and Spot Red Phosphorus
steps.instruction: Apply Red Phosphorous (RedP) (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #343242-5G, CAS: 7723-14-0) to a calibrant spot.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend RedP by shaking gently before and during the step.
Spot 1 µL of RedP onto a calibrant spot 4-5 times.
Allow 00:00:20 between each dispense for the layer to dry.

steps.title: Perform Instrument Calibration
steps.instruction: Load the plate into the instrument, establish vacuum, and acquire calibration data using the specified settings.

substeps.instruction: Settings: Positive; MRT; Standard; 1.0s; 9600; API Gas flow rate 350 mL/min; Laser Rate 2500 Hz; Laser Intensity 300; Lens Focus 4.00 mm; Step Size: X 1000 μm and Y 100 μm; Scan Time 1.0 sec; Decoding Threshold Automatic; Function MS.
Accept calibration only if the Mean Prediction Error is ≤ 0.2 ppm.

steps.title: Optimize Laser Intensity
steps.instruction: Confirm optimum laser settings using the spotted ADH by testing three laser intensities: 250, 300, and 350.

steps.title: Acquire ADH Standard Data
steps.instruction: Acquire data for the ADH instrument standard using the recommended settings to ensure functionality.

substeps.instruction: Settings: Positive; MRT; Standard; API Gas; 1.0s; 9600; Laser Rate 2500 Hz; Lens Focus 4.00 mm; Well Diameter: 2.15 mm; Step Size: X 500 μm and Y 150 μm; Scan Time 1.0 sec; m/z range 1000 - 3500; Decoding Threshold Low; Function MS.
Manual Quad Profile: Dwell time 20% at 1000 m/z, 40% at 1500 m/z; Top end mass 3000 m/z; Ramp time 20%.
Verify that key peptide peaks at 2744 m/z and 3369 m/z are observed.

steps.title: Acquire Sample Data
steps.instruction: Acquire sample data using the same settings as the ADH instrument standard, with the laser intensity set to the previously optimized value.

substeps.instruction: Set the instrument to acquire all sample data, followed by one ADH spot to confirm consistency.
Perform 30 scans per spot, which will be summed.

steps.title: Clean the Plate
steps.instruction: Rinse and sonicate the plate to remove residue.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the plate with Methanol (MeOH) (Fisher Scientific UK Catalog #10653963, CAS: 67-56-1).
Manually wipe any remaining residue with a cotton bud damp with MeOH.
Sonicate the plate in 50:50 MeOH and Water (Fisher Scientific UK Catalog #10777404) for 00:15:00.
Dry in the fume hood using regular extraction or a Nitrogen gas tube.

steps.title: Process Raw Data
steps.instruction: Convert and sum the raw data files for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Convert Waters raw data files (.raw) to mzML format using MSConvert from ProteoWizard.
Sum individual scans into .txt files using the MZSummer Python script.
Merge technical replicates in R using MALDIquant and MALDIquantForeign packages if necessary.
